```{r}
library(pheatmap)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

# ======================================================================
# 1. Load Clean Pipeline Objects (RDS)
# ======================================================================
pp_90            <- readRDS(here("Outputs", "pp_99_filtered.rds"))
fit_90           <- readRDS(here("Outputs", "fit_pvclust_99.rds"))
ed_90_multiverse <- readRDS(here("Outputs", "ed_99_multiverse.rds"))

# Define custom species colors
species_colors <- c(
  "AABR" = "#046E8F", 
  "AGLO" = "lightgreen", 
  "AHYA" = "#D44D5C",
  "ICRA" = "#462255"  
)

# =========================================================================
# 2. Extract Dendrogram & Format Matrix
# =========================================================================
# Grab hclust object directly from pvclust fit
my_hclust <- fit_90$hclust
original_labels <- my_hclust$labels

# Format physiological matrix with samples as rows
heatmap_matrix <- pp_90 %>%
  column_to_rownames("sample_file") %>%
  dplyr::select(-any_of(c("timepoint", "site", "genotype", "GroupingProperty")))

# Align matrix rows to match dendrogram leaf order
heatmap_matrix <- heatmap_matrix[match(original_labels, rownames(heatmap_matrix)), ] %>%
  as.matrix()

# Transpose (traits in rows, samples in columns), z-score scale, and cap outliers [-3, 3]
heatmap_matrix_scaled <- t(scale(heatmap_matrix))
heatmap_matrix_scaled[heatmap_matrix_scaled > 3]  <- 3
heatmap_matrix_scaled[heatmap_matrix_scaled < -3] <- -3

# Keep column names matched to messy tree labels
colnames(heatmap_matrix_scaled) <- original_labels

# =========================================================================
# 3. Filter Metrics & Prepare Row Annotations
# =========================================================================
# Filter out raw fluorescence baselines if present
metric_names <- rownames(heatmap_matrix_scaled)
keep_metrics <- metric_names[!metric_names %in% c("Fm", "Fo", "fm", "fo")]
heatmap_matrix_scaled <- heatmap_matrix_scaled[keep_metrics, ]

# Build row annotation categories
metric_names <- rownames(heatmap_matrix_scaled)
annotation_row <- data.frame(Metric = case_when(
  grepl("Quant",   metric_names, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Quant (Quantum Yield)",
  grepl("Sigma",   metric_names, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Sigma (Antenna Size)",
  grepl("Connect", metric_names, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Connect (Connectivity)",
  grepl("Tau1",    metric_names, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Tau1 (Transport Kinetics 1)",
  grepl("Tau2",    metric_names, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Tau2 (Transport Kinetics 2)",
  grepl("NPQ",     metric_names, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "NPQ (Non-Photochemical Quenching)",
  grepl("qP",      metric_names, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "qP (Photochemical Quenching)",
  grepl("ABQ",     metric_names, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "ABQ (Absorption)",
  grepl("qm",      metric_names, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "qm (Max Quenching)",
  TRUE                                               ~ "Other Metric"
))
rownames(annotation_row) <- metric_names

metric_colors <- c(
  "Quant (Quantum Yield)"             = "#1F77B4", # Strong Blue
  "Sigma (Antenna Size)"              = "#FF7F0E", # Vivid Orange
  "Connect (Connectivity)"            = "#2CA02C", # Leaf Green
  "Tau1 (Transport Kinetics 1)"       = "#D62728", # Crimson Red
  "Tau2 (Transport Kinetics 2)"       = "#9467BD", # Purple
  "NPQ (Non-Photochemical Quenching)" = "#8C564B", # Warm Brown
  "qP (Photochemical Quenching)"      = "#E377C2", # Pink/Rose
  "ABQ (Absorption)"                  = "#17BECF", # Cyan
  "qm (Max Quenching)"                = "#BCBD22", # Olive Yellow
  "Other Metric"                      = "#7F7F7F"  # Slate Grey
)

# Package into list for pheatmap
ann_colors <- list(Metric = metric_colors)

# Sort Matrix and Row Annotations alphabetically by Category
sorted_order <- order(annotation_row$Metric)
heatmap_matrix_scaled <- heatmap_matrix_scaled[sorted_order, ]
annotation_row        <- annotation_row[sorted_order, , drop = FALSE]

# =========================================================================
# 4. Prepare Column Metadata (ed_90_multiverse)
# =========================================================================
# Ensure matching keys exist
pp_90_keys <- pp_90 %>%
  mutate(
    tp_num    = str_match(sample_file, "^t(\\d+)")[,2],
    geno_name = toupper(str_match(sample_file, "^t\\d+_([a-zA-Z]+)")[,2]),
    rep_num   = str_match(sample_file, "^t\\d+_[a-zA-Z]+(\\d+)")[,2],
    GroupingProperty = paste(tp_num, geno_name, rep_num, sep = "_")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(sample_file, GroupingProperty)

annotation_col <- pp_90_keys %>%
  left_join(ed_90_multiverse, by = "GroupingProperty") %>%
  distinct(sample_file, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  rename_with(~ "species", matches("^Species$"))

# Match metadata rows directly to original tree labels
annotation_col <- annotation_col[match(original_labels, annotation_col$sample_file), ]
rownames(annotation_col) <- annotation_col$sample_file

#Select annotation tracks for display
annotation_col <- annotation_col %>%
  dplyr::select(species, K_3, K_4, K_6, K_11, ED50) %>%
  mutate(across(c(species, K_3, K_4, K_6, K_11), as.factor))
# annotation_col <- annotation_col %>% 
#   dplyr::select( K_3) %>%
#   mutate(across(c( K_3), as.factor))

# Color mappings for tracks
annotation_colors <- list(
  species = species_colors
)

# =========================================================================
# 5. Export Heatmap Plot
# =========================================================================
my_palette <- colorRampPalette(c("darkblue", "white", "darkred"))(100)
my_breaks <- seq(-3, 3, length.out = 101)

jpeg(
  file   = here("Plots", "Sorted_Grouped_Physiological_Heatmap_pp90.jpg"), 
  width  = 12, 
  height = 10, 
  units  = "in", 
  res    = 300
)

pheatmap(
  heatmap_matrix_scaled,
  annotation_colors = ann_colors,
  annotation_col    = annotation_col,
  annotation_row    = annotation_row,
  show_colnames     = FALSE,         
  show_rownames     = FALSE,          
  cluster_rows      = FALSE,         
  cluster_cols      = my_hclust,     
  color             = my_palette,            
  breaks            = my_breaks,            
  main              = "Sorted MAPP Fluorescence Metrics vs. Clusters (pp_90)",
  margins           = c(5, 20)       
)

dev.off()
```



NEW
```{r}
library(pheatmap)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(pvclust)
library(here)

# =========================================================================
# 1. LOAD PREPROCESSED DATA & CLUSTERING FIT
# =========================================================================

# Load preprocessed environment (contains metric_families, ed_aligned)
load(here("Outputs", "photophys_preprocessed_data.RData"))

# Load pvclust fit (assumes fit_pvclust_99 was computed on permanova_matrix_filtered)
fit_90 <- readRDS(here("Outputs", "fit_pvclust_99.rds"))

# Define custom species colors
species_colors <- c(
  "AABR" = "#046E8F", 
  "AGLO" = "lightgreen", 
  "AHYA" = "#D44D5C",
  "ICRA" = "#462255"  
)

# =========================================================================
# 2. EXTRACT DENDROGRAM & BUILD SCALED HEATMAP MATRIX
# =========================================================================

# Grab hclust tree directly from pvclust fit
my_hclust <- fit_90$hclust
original_labels <- my_hclust$labels # SampleIDs (e.g., "11_AABR_1")

# Subset matrix to retain only collinearity-filtered metrics
# Transpose so metrics are rows and samples are columns
heatmap_matrix <- t(permanova_matrix_filtered)

# Align columns to match leaf order of the dendrogram
heatmap_matrix <- heatmap_matrix[, match(original_labels, colnames(heatmap_matrix))]

# Z-score scale across metrics (rows) and cap outliers [-3, 3]
heatmap_matrix_scaled <- t(scale(t(heatmap_matrix)))
heatmap_matrix_scaled[is.na(heatmap_matrix_scaled) | is.nan(heatmap_matrix_scaled)] <- 0
heatmap_matrix_scaled[heatmap_matrix_scaled > 3]  <- 3
heatmap_matrix_scaled[heatmap_matrix_scaled < -3] <- -3

# Drop raw baseline metrics (Fm/Fo) if present
keep_metrics <- !rownames(heatmap_matrix_scaled) %in% c("Fm", "Fo", "fm", "fo", "F0", "FM")
heatmap_matrix_scaled <- heatmap_matrix_scaled[keep_metrics, , drop = FALSE]

# =========================================================================
# 3. PREPARE ROW ANNOTATIONS (METRIC FAMILIES)
# =========================================================================

# Filter metric_families table to match active matrix rows
annotation_row <- metric_families %>%
  filter(Metric %in% rownames(heatmap_matrix_scaled)) %>%
  select(Metric, Family) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Metric")

# Sort Matrix and Row Annotations alphabetically by Family
sorted_order <- order(annotation_row$Family)
heatmap_matrix_scaled <- heatmap_matrix_scaled[sorted_order, ]
annotation_row         <- annotation_row[sorted_order, , drop = FALSE]

# Define palette for metric families
metric_colors <- c(
  "Quant (Quantum Yield)"             = "#1F77B4", # Strong Blue
  "Sigma (Antenna Size)"              = "#FF7F0E", # Vivid Orange
  "Connect (Connectivity)"            = "#2CA02C", # Leaf Green
  "Connect (Normalized Curves)"       = "#2CA02C", 
  "Tau1 (Transport Kinetics 1)"       = "#D62728", # Crimson Red
  "Tau2 (Transport Kinetics 2)"       = "#9467BD", # Purple
  "NPQ (Non-Photochemical Quenching)" = "#8C564B", # Warm Brown
  "qP (Photochemical Quenching)"      = "#E377C2", # Pink/Rose
  "ABQ (Absorption)"                  = "#17BECF", # Cyan
  "qm (Max Quenching)"                = "#BCBD22", # Olive Yellow
  "OJIP Kinetics (Derivatives)"       = "#98DF8A", # Light Green
  "OJIP Ratios & Area"                = "#FFBB78", # Light Orange
  "Other Metric"                      = "#7F7F7F"  # Slate Grey
)

# =========================================================================
# 4. PREPARE COLUMN ANNOTATIONS (SAMPLES)
# =========================================================================

# Match ed_aligned metadata directly to tree labels
annotation_col <- ed_aligned %>%
  filter(SampleID_clean %in% colnames(heatmap_matrix_scaled)) %>%
  arrange(match(SampleID_clean, colnames(heatmap_matrix_scaled))) %>%
  column_to_rownames("SampleID_clean") %>%
  select(Species, any_of(c("K_3", "K_4", "K_6", "K_11")), ED50) %>%
  mutate(across(c(Species, any_of(c("K_3", "K_4", "K_6", "K_11"))), as.factor))

# Combine color maps for pheatmap
ann_colors <- list(
  Family  = metric_colors,
  Species = species_colors
)

# =========================================================================
# 5. RENDER & EXPORT HEATMAP
# =========================================================================

my_palette <- colorRampPalette(c("darkblue", "white", "darkred"))(100)
my_breaks  <- seq(-3, 3, length.out = 101)

jpeg(
  file   = here("Plots", "Sorted_Grouped_Physiological_Heatmap_Filtered.jpg"), 
  width  = 12, 
  height = 10, 
  units  = "in", 
  res    = 300
)

pheatmap(
  heatmap_matrix_scaled,
  annotation_colors = ann_colors,
  annotation_col    = annotation_col,
  annotation_row    = annotation_row,
  show_colnames     = FALSE,         
  show_rownames     = FALSE,         
  cluster_rows      = FALSE, # Preserves alphabetical Family sorting
  cluster_cols      = my_hclust, # Direct pvclust tree      
  color             = my_palette,            
  breaks            = my_breaks,            
  main              = "Collinearity-Filtered MAPP Fluorescence Metrics vs. Clusters",
  margins           = c(5, 20)       
)

dev.off()
```
